description: The Housing and Land Survey, run every five years by the Statistics Bureau of Japan, describes the country's dwellings, the living conditions of the households in them and the land they own, and is used for the Basic Plan for Housing under the Basic Act for Housing and for land use policy. The 2023 survey, taken at 1 October 2023, was released in three tabulations: basic tabulation on dwellings and households (25 September 2024), tabulation on housing structure and related items (29 January 2025) and land tabulation (26 March 2025). Tables are published on the e-Stat portal for the nation, prefectures and municipalities, with lists of the areas tabulated; the English pages give outlines, sampling and reliability notes and term explanations for surveys back to 1998. Coverage: Japan, with municipal detail. Access: statistical tables on e-Stat, free; outlines and term definitions as PDF. Licence: e-Stat terms of use, not read. Caveats: it is a sample survey, so small-area figures carry sampling error, and definitions change between rounds. Simulation uses are dwelling stock by structure, age and occupancy for earthquake, flood and heat exposure and housing policy models. Related records: PLATEAU 3D city models, and the INSEE and Zensus housing bases for comparison.
